mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (id, username, display_name, body_text, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{bodyText}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, display_name, body_text, created_at FROM chat_messages ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, username, display_name, body_text, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE id = #{id}
